description: This PHP class 'Media' handles embedding various media types (YouTube, Vimeo, Slideshare, Prezi, Blip, GissTV, PeerTube) through generating embed codes based on URLs. It also manages certain media URL configurations and provides methods to produce embed HTML snippets.

classes.name: Media
classes.description: A class for generating embed codes for various media platforms based on URLs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that normalizes the provided URL to use HTTPS.

methods.name: getEmbedCode
methods.description: Generates the embed HTML code for the media URL, supporting multiple platforms.

methods.name: getPeerTubeBaseDomainUrl
methods.description: Determines the base domain for PeerTube URLs from a given URL.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the media URL as a string.
